en.title: Provider: three analyses on paid Anthropic
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
The parallel design of the speed pair, run on a paid provider.

**What it teaches**

A paid provider costs money but has no daily limit of a free account; compare it with the free run of the same design.

cs.title: Provider: tři rozbory na placeném Anthropicu
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Souběžný návrh z dvojice o rychlosti na placeném providerovi.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Placený provider stojí peníze, ale nemá denní limit bezplatného účtu; porovnejte ho s bezplatným během téhož návrhu.

teaches.en: A paid provider costs money but has no daily limit of a free account; compare it with the free run of the same design.
